annotations.title: Check who can read and write Supabase tables (RLS, policies, grants)

description: Use when you write, review or are about to apply Supabase / PostgreSQL migration SQL (CREATE TABLE, RLS, CREATE POLICY, GRANT, views, SECURITY DEFINER functions, storage buckets), or when a user asks whether their Supabase data is exposed, whether RLS is set up right, or why a query returns 42501 permission denied or no rows. Replays the SQL with real Postgres rules and returns, per table, what signed-out (anon) and signed-in (authenticated) users can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (all rows, own rows, some rows, none, or denied for a missing grant), plus findings with severity and ready-to-run fix SQL: RLS off, policies written but RLS never enabled, using(true) writes, personal columns readable by anyone, views that bypass RLS, SECURITY DEFINER functions anyone can call, user_metadata in policies, public bucket listing, grants missing after the Oct 30 2026 default change. Also accepts the JSON produced by deadbolt_catalog_query for the live database. Deterministic; never connects to any database. Run it before telling a user their schema is safe. Up to 200,000 characters.

project_created_before_2026_10_30.description: Only for SQL input. true (default): the project grants new public tables to anon and authenticated automatically (projects created before Oct 30, 2026). false: new tables get no grants unless the SQL grants them (projects created on or after Oct 30, 2026).

sql.description: Migration SQL (one or many files concatenated, in order), or the single JSON value returned by the catalog query.
